quest.title: The Littlest Journey: Non-Emergency Food
quest.description: Little Meng is making preparations for his trip...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Argh! It... It failed again...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you working on?

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Eh? Oh, Traveler, it's you.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Remember the dish you taught me how to cook the last time? Well, I was just trying to make it... But I haven't been successful yet. Not even once.

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: I was thinking that I might be using the wrong ingredients...

dialogues.speaker: Little Meng
dialogues.text: Could you try teaching me again?
